subject: english
question:
Choose the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence:

(A) served

(B) dinner

(C) they

(D) late
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To form a meaningful sentence, we must follow the correct grammatical order: **Subject + Verb + Object + Adverb**.
 
• **Sentence C is the first part** as it provides the subject:
 
 
• "they"
 
 
 
• **Sentence A follows** as the verb:
 
 
• "served"
 
 
 
• **Sentence B comes next** as the object:
 
 
• "dinner"
 
 
 
• **Sentence D is the last part** as it adds additional information (adverb of time):
 
 
• "late"
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is **CABD**.

 

**Coherent sentence after rearrangement**:

"They served dinner late."
